import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "font.weight": "normal", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.usetex": False, "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" OCHRE = "#D4A72C" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786" LIGHT = "#D9E1E3" colors = [BLUE, TEAL, OCHRE]
# Analytic geometry for three equally spaced, equal-mass points. h = np.sqrt(3) / 2 vectors = np.array([[1.0, 0.0], [-0.5, h], [-0.5, -h]]) path = np.vstack(([0.0, 0.0], np.cumsum(vectors, axis=0))) assert np.allclose(path[-1], [0.0, 0.0])
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4), facecolor="white") left = fig.add_axes([0.035, 0.215, 0.455, 0.585]) right = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.215, 0.440, 0.585])
fig.text(0.5, 0.957, "Symmetry cancels the center of mass", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=17, weight="normal") fig.text(0.5, 0.884, "N = 3 uniformly spaced, equal-mass points · Unit radius · Dimensionless coordinates", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color=SLATE)
fig.text(0.062, 0.817, "a Vectors on the unit circle", fontsize=11, weight="normal") fig.text(0.552, 0.817, "b Tip-to-tail addition", fontsize=11, weight="normal")
for ax in (left, right): ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.axis("off")
def arrow(ax, start, end, color, width=2.5, scale=12, zorder=4): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=scale, linewidth=width, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, capstyle="round", joinstyle="round", zorder=zorder ) ax.add_patch(patch) return patch
left.set_xlim(-1.62, 1.72) left.set_ylim(-1.43, 1.37) left.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=LIGHT, linewidth=1.3, zorder=1))
triangle = np.vstack((vectors, vectors[0])) left.plot(triangle[:, 0], triangle[:, 1], color=LIGHT, linewidth=1.0, zorder=1)
arrow(left, (-1.22, 0), (1.33, 0), LIGHT, width=0.9, scale=7, zorder=0) arrow(left, (0, -1.14), (0, 1.16), LIGHT, width=0.9, scale=7, zorder=0) left.text(1.36, -0.05, "$x$", color=SLATE, fontsize=10) left.text(0.06, 1.12, "$y$", color=SLATE, fontsize=10)
# Both left vertices project to x = -1/2. for v in vectors[1:]: left.plot([v[0], v[0]], [v[1], 0], color=SLATE, linewidth=0.9, linestyle=(0, (2, 3)), alpha=0.65, zorder=1)
for v, color in zip(vectors, colors): arrow(left, (0, 0), v, color) left.scatter(*v, s=22, color=color, zorder=5)
left.scatter(0, 0, s=32, color=INK, zorder=6) left.annotate("CM (0, 0)", xy=(0, 0), xytext=(-1.46, -0.24), fontsize=9, ha="left", va="center", arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=SLATE, lw=0.8, shrinkA=3, shrinkB=5))
left.text(0.66, 0.18, r"$\mathbf{v}_0=(1,\,0)$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, ha="center") left.text(0.72, -0.28, r"$\theta_0=0$", color=BLUE, fontsize=9, ha="center") left.text(-0.57, 1.22, r"$\mathbf{v}_1=(-\frac{1}{2},\,\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})$", color=TEAL, fontsize=10, ha="center") left.text(-0.86, 0.61, r"$\theta_1=\frac{2\pi}{3}$", color=TEAL, fontsize=9, ha="right") left.text(-0.57, -1.20, r"$\mathbf{v}_2=(-\frac{1}{2},\,-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})$", color=OCHRE, fontsize=10, ha="center") left.text(-0.86, -0.67, r"$\theta_2=\frac{4\pi}{3}$", color=OCHRE, fontsize=9, ha="right") left.text(-0.5, -0.09, r"$-\frac{1}{2}$", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="center", va="top")
right.set_xlim(-0.25, 2.43) right.set_ylim(-0.83, 1.16)
arrow(right, (-0.16, 0), (1.34, 0), LIGHT, width=0.9, scale=7, zorder=0) right.text(1.38, -0.03, "$x$", fontsize=10, color=SLATE) right.plot([0.5, 0.5], [0, h], color=SLATE, linewidth=0.9, linestyle=(0, (2, 3)), alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
for i, color in enumerate(colors): arrow(right, path[i], path[i + 1], color)
right.scatter([0, 1, 0.5], [0, 0, h], s=20, color=INK, zorder=6) right.text(0.5, 0.09, r"$\mathbf{v}_0$", color=BLUE, fontsize=11, ha="center") right.text(0.87, 0.49, r"$\mathbf{v}_1$", color=TEAL, fontsize=11, ha="left") right.text(0.13, 0.49, r"$\mathbf{v}_2$", color=OCHRE, fontsize=11, ha="right") right.text(0.5, 1.025, r"$\mathbf{v}_0+\mathbf{v}_1+\mathbf{v}_2=\mathbf{0}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11) right.text(-0.04, -0.07, r"$(0,0)$", fontsize=9, ha="right", va="top") right.text(0.5, -0.065, r"$\frac{1}{2}$", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="center", va="top") right.text(1.0, -0.065, "$1$", color=SLATE, fontsize=9, ha="center", va="top")
projection_rows = [ (-0.30, 0.0, 1.0, BLUE, r"$x_0=\cos(0)=1$"), (-0.51, 1.0, 0.5, TEAL, r"$x_1=\cos(2\pi/3)=-0.5$"), (-0.72, 0.5, 0.0, OCHRE, r"$x_2=\cos(4\pi/3)=-0.5$"), ] for y, x_start, x_end, color, label in projection_rows: arrow(right, (x_start, y), (x_end, y), color, width=2.1, scale=10) right.text(1.15, y, label, color=color, fontsize=9, va="center", ha="left")
fig.text(0.5, 0.121, r"$\sum_{k=0}^{2}x_k=1+(-0.5)+(-0.5)=0$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13)
# Native matplotlib mathtext does not support the LaTeX \displaystyle command. fig.text(0.5, 0.045, r"Equal masses: $\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{CM}}" r"=\frac{1}{3}\sum_{k=0}^{2}\mathbf{v}_k=(0,\,0)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, color=INK)
